gloss: change of pace; refreshment; mood change

definitions.gloss: change of pace; refreshment; mood change
definitions.explanation: taking a break or doing something different to refresh oneself mentally

examples.japanese: {気分転換|きぶんてんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I went for a walk to refresh myself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合間|あいま}→合間：05708_aima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気分転換|きぶんてんかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: I need a change of pace between work sessions.

examples.japanese: {気分転換|きぶんてんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I decided to go on a trip to get a change of scenery.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧ (mood/feeling) + ⟦{転換|てんかん}→転換：19439_tenkan⟧ (change/switch)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気分転換|きぶんてんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧～⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to do ~ as a change of pace
- {気分転換|きぶんてんかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ - need a change of pace
- {気分転換|きぶんてんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - serves as a refreshment
- {気分転換|きぶんてんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧ - to seek a change of pace (formal)

USAGE:
Used when someone needs to step away from stress, work, or routine activities to mentally refresh themselves. Common activities include:
- ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧ (taking a walk)
- ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧ (traveling)
- ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧ (hobbies)
- ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ (exercise)
